Number base converter

Convert whole numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal without losing integer precision.

Use digits only, with an optional minus sign. Omit prefixes such as 0x or 0b.

Your result

—

Exact integers, different representations

Decimal 255 is hexadecimal FF, binary 11111111, and octal 377. These are different representations of the same integer.

Calculations use integer arithmetic, preserving values larger than JavaScript’s ordinary safe-integer limit. Inputs may contain up to 4,096 digits. Fractions and scientific notation are not supported.
